description: Source file defining the NotifyOverlayController class that manages in-app toast notifications for a macOS application. It handles presentation, dismissal, and layout of notification overlays within the app window.

classes.name: NotifyOverlayController
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for managing toast-style overlay notifications within a macOS app, including presentation, auto-dismissal, and layout updates.

methods.name: present
methods.description: Displays a notification overlay with given title and body, optionally auto-dismissing after a specified interval.

methods.name: dismiss
methods.description: Dismisses the currently visible notification overlay.
